name: Barbell Snatch Balance
steps: Support a barbell across your upper back with a wide overhand snatch grip and feet hip-width apart.
Dip slightly with your torso upright, then drive upward briefly through your legs.
Drop rapidly into a full squat while moving your feet to your squat stance and punching your arms locked straight overhead.
Stabilize the bar over your midfoot, stand tall smoothly, and lower the bar safely back onto your upper back.
tips: Push yourself down under the bar quickly rather than pressing it slowly overhead.
Lock your elbows sharply as you hit the bottom of the squat and keep your chest tall.
